## History

Joe Sloane was a pupil in Anne's classroom. During a frustrating day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly ordered him to throw a package into the school stove, which resulted in an explosion of firecrackers.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P18](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0018), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--joe-sloane.md)

Joe Sloane is a student in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's classroom, serving under her authority as a pupil. During a difficult day in the schoolhouse, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally orders a student to throw a package into the stove, triggering an explosion of firecrackers.
